# لوحة عربي — Arabic Keyboard & Text Tools

Real multi-page static site (Phase 2 of the project): clean-URL routes,
a shared design system, and reusable JS components, generated by a small
Python build script instead of one big single-page HTML file.

## Structure

```
build/
  build.py     — component library (header, nav, footer, breadcrumbs, FAQ, cards, page())
  pages.py     — content for every route, calls build.py to assemble + write each page
assets/
  css/styles.css        — the entire shared design system (one file, no duplication)
  js/app.js              — theme toggle, mobile nav, toast, FAQ accordion, SW registration
  js/keyboard-tool.js    — editor + virtual keyboard + transliteration (shared component)
  js/typing-test.js      — typing test engine (shared by /typing-test/ and /arabic-typing-test/)
  js/tashkeel-tool.js    — tashkeel preview component
  js/alphabet.js         — alphabet + letter-forms component
  js/*-init.js           — tiny per-page wiring files that call the shared components above
  icons/                 — app icon source (SVG) + generated PNGs
manifest.json  — PWA manifest
sw.js          — service worker (offline app shell for the core tools)
robots.txt
dist/          — GENERATED. This is what you deploy. Never edit dist/ by hand.
```

## Build

```
cd build
python3 pages.py
```

Regenerates `dist/` from scratch (static HTML pages with clean URLs,
`sitemap.xml`, and copies of `assets/`, `manifest.json`, `sw.js`, `robots.txt`).

## Deploying

`dist/` is a plain static site — upload it to any static host (Netlify,
Vercel, Cloudflare Pages, GitHub Pages, S3+CloudFront, nginx, etc.). It
needs a real HTTP server for the clean URLs (`/arabic-keyboard/` →
`/arabic-keyboard/index.html`) and the service worker to work; opening
the files directly via `file://` will not resolve the root-relative
`/assets/...` and `/manifest.json` paths.

Before going live:
- Update `SITE_URL` in `build/build.py` (currently a placeholder) and rebuild,
  so canonical URLs, Open Graph tags, and sitemap.xml point at your real domain.
- Update the `Sitemap:` line in `robots.txt` to match.

## Known intentional limitations (see chat for full list)

- **Tashkeel** is a simple client-side heuristic preview, clearly labeled
  as such in the UI — not a real NLP diacritization model.
- **Theme preference is not persisted** across page loads (defaults to
  system preference each time). This was left out deliberately so the
  site is safe to preview inside sandboxed artifact viewers that block
  `localStorage`. Add a `localStorage`-backed persistence layer in
  `assets/js/app.js` before shipping if you want the theme to stick.
- **Translation** (mentioned in the original toolbar) is not implemented —
  it would need a real translation API and isn't included here.
- The contact form is a front-end demo only; it needs a real backend or
  form service (e.g. Formspree, a serverless function) to actually send mail.
